articles.title: Civilization 7 to get Atomic Age via free update, major sci-fi expansion planned for 2027
articles.description: Civilization 7 is set to get a new Atomic Age via an free update, extending play into the 2050s with revised progression systems, nuclear mechanics, diplomacy and city-state conflicts. The Earthrise expansion will introduce space exploration across all eras, while Update 1.5.0 adds new maps, resource-generation improvements and interface upgrades.
